machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

case.prompt: A red fox asleep beside a mossy stone in soft morning light.

method.input_scope: Committed official prompt embeddings, RoPE, and seeded initial noise
method.execution: One native process: mixed packed transformer and BF16-rounded FlowMatch trajectory, caller-owned latent handoff, FP32 VAE, exact Diffusers RGBA postprocessing, pure-C+ PNG output
method.memory_phases: The transformer function returns and releases its packed mapping/workspaces before the VAE mapping is opened
method.png: RGBA8, filter-none scanlines, zlib stored DEFLATE blocks, Adler-32 and PNG CRC-32, atomically installed

interpretation: The 1.00476% accumulated latent divergence remains controlled through VAE decode and pixel quantization. Keeping postprocessing under an exact independent gate distinguishes model arithmetic error from byte conversion or image encoding errors.
limitations: The command is fixture-driven and does not yet tokenize or encode an arbitrary prompt.
Initial noise, prompt embeddings, and RoPE are committed inputs; native seeded random generation is not implemented.
The latent handoff is in process and in memory, but copies from shared Metal memory into a 64 KiB host array before the VAE input buffer is created.
The fixed vertical slice is 256x256 RGBA and uses the verified still-image first-chunk VAE path.
Summed GPU time excludes packed-file validation, Metal compilation, CPU scheduler work, PNG encoding, fixture I/O, and process startup.
The correctness-first transformer remains far too slow for interactive 1024px generation.
